objective.title: Objective
objective.body: Be the first to amass 50+ warriors 🧍 and slay the Dragon 🐉 to claim victory!

turnOrder.title: Turn order
turnOrder.step1: Roll the dice 🎲 (or shake your phone 📳) and move your hero around the board
turnOrder.step2: Take action based on the tile you land on
turnOrder.step3: Upgrade or sell your tiles if needed
turnOrder.step5: Each circle makes a year — pass the 🏰 King's Castle to receive the rewards

goldUnits.title: Gold 🟡 and units 🧍
goldUnits.item1: Gold 🟡 and units 🧍 are the basic resources used to buy tiles, fight or start a final battle
goldUnits.item2: Yearly income: more tiles you own, more you get each year
goldUnits.item3: A hero's army can hold up to 5 squads, each squad holding up to 10 units of the same kind (🧍 or 🐎). Number of squads depends on your fame 🏆
goldUnits.item4: Once fame reaches {knightFame}🏆, the hero becomes a Knight and can hire pricier but more powerful Rider units 🐎 at the King's Castle.
goldUnits.item5: 🧍 can be sold to buy 🐎 instead (or just for the gold) — press ✖️ next to a squad while at the King's Castle.
goldUnits.item6: Units like 🧟👹🥷 are equal or almost equal to 🧍. Dragon 🐉 is equal to 🐎.

fame.title: Fame 🏆
fame.item1: It's your reputation. It depends on each battle won or lost and tiles owned.
fame.item2: Fame {knightFame} or more makes you eligible for promotion — the King knights you (unlocking Rider recruiting) next time you cross his Castle. It also makes you more visible for a dragon - beware, it could attack!
fame.item3: More fame allows to recruit more units at the King's Castle, increases your stable units 🧍 income and allows to own the best tiles

tiles.title: Tiles 🧩
tiles.discoverBody: new tiles and get rewarded for that
tiles.own: 👛 Own tiles by spending gold 🟡 and 🧍 units. Visiting own tiles brings you bonus from it
tiles.landingOnOpponent: Landing on opponent's tile — pay a fee 💰 or battle ⚔️ to raze it. Razed 🔥 tile loses all upgrades and becomes unowned, but cannot be claimed by that player after the battle. If you don't have enough gold or units, sell some of your tiles. Battle costs units to the attacker. If you can neither battle, nor pay, you become a prisoner of war: spend 2 turns in a prison, after that receive some starting bonus to continue playing.
tiles.syndicates: Syndicates — own every tile of some group and you form a syndicate: income bonus and fee is doubled
tiles.sellAnytime: Sell — tiles can be sold at any time for the full price of the tile and its upgrades. Click the tile's heading to reveal the Sell/Yield buttons.
tiles.yieldToKing: Yield to the King — yield a tile ('half-sold'): receive half its price immediately, but it produces no income and can't be fought over. Take it back for 60% of the tile's price. Selling a yielded tile refunds 10% less than its remaining value.
tiles.clickToView: Click on the tile's title or data to view its bonuses and defences on each level

tileUpgrades.title: Tile upgrades ⬆️
tileUpgrades.item1: Upgrade tiles paying 🟡 to increase tile's income and defence. Click the ⬆️ button to upgrade, click the title to display possible upgrades.
tileUpgrades.item2: Each upgrade brings one more garrison tower 🏯 to the tile. Each tower can hold up to 10 defending units and adds a bonus to their defence rolls.
tileUpgrades.item3: Upgrades can't be sold separately or dismantled, but their price is added to the tile's price value.

specialTiles.title: Special tiles 🃏
specialTiles.kingsCastle: 🏰 King's Castle — visit to recruit 🧍 units for gold, the amount is limited by your fame. Passing the King's Castle grants base income plus bonuses from all your properties.
specialTiles.sphynx:
🦁 Sphynx:
Roll dice 🎲:
1,2 - lose half of your 🟡
3,4 - lose 1/3 🧍
5 - nothing, exhale 🌬️
6 - gain half of your 🟡
specialTiles.prison: ⛓️ Prison — skip a turn. While you're in prison, noone pays for visiting your tiles
specialTiles.joker: 🃏 Joker — triggers a random global event, see below for the full list.

joker.title: Joker 🃏
joker.intro: Landing on the Joker tile triggers one random event, affecting everyone (or, in some cases, just one player):
joker.taxes: 🧾 Taxes — all players lose half of their gold.
joker.plague: 🦠 Plague — all players lose half of their units.
joker.hurricane: 🌪️ Hurricane — every player loses their most expensive tile.
joker.blessing: 👑 Blessing — all owned tiles are upgraded one level.
joker.queensGift: 💍 Queen's Gift — the player who rolled it gets a free Camp/Tower tile, or 2000🟡 and 5🧍 if none are free.
joker.earthquake: 🪨 Earthquake — upgraded tiles lose a level; players with no upgraded tiles lose their cheapest tile instead.
joker.meteor: ☄️ Meteor — strikes a random tile owned by the richest player, razing it.

caravan.title: Caravan 🐪
caravan.item1: At the start of your turn you have a chance to encounter a caravan bringing treasures or slaves
caravan.item2: Defeat the caravan guards to free the slaves (they join your army) or pillage the treasures!

battle.title: Battle ⚔️
battle.squad: The attacker sends a squad of units in amount equal to 🛡️ Defence value, risking their lives for some goal: caravan goods or slaves, razing the tile or fighting the Dragon.
battle.razing: Razing means the tile loses all its upgrades and belongs to no one
battle.twoModes: There are two modes: brawl and normal battle
battle.brawlMode: In Brawl mode: Simple mode, used when squad is less than 6 units. Attacker and defender roll dice, who rolls more, wins the round.
battle.normalMode: Normal battle: Combat is resolved in rounds. Each round both sides roll the dice; the amount rolled is the number of enemy units destroyed. The one to destroy all enemy units first wins.
battle.tie: If all attacker and defender units are killed, that's a Tie
battle.priceOfVictory: The victory comes with a price! As a result of a battle, winner loses units killed in battle.

artifacts.title: Artifacts
artifacts.intro: Found inside Treasure Chests 📦 — each artifact grants its owner a permanent bonus for the rest of the game.

dragon.title: Dragon 🐉
dragon.item1: If you have more than 50 warriors at the start of your turn — choose to challenge the Dragon or roll dice instead.
dragon.item2: Sometimes while travelling you may see the dragon in the sky. And if you're rich and famous, beware: he could attack you and burn your tiles to the ground!
